title: Cannot Configure Thunderbird for My email Account
creator: adita2
content:
I recently installed Thunderbird on both of my Windows 10 PCs.

I have two email accounts:

adita@shaw.ca

and

adita2@shaw.ca

The first account worked perfectly upon completing the Thunderbird set up.

The second account does not work and I have spent hours playing with various Configuration options.

It's very strange that BOTH of these email address successfully pass the "Connection Security" test.

I'm out of ideas.

Incidentally, I still have Eudora 7 on my PC and BOTH emails are working fine in that application.

Hopefully, you can assist me to resolve this problem.
